about: The Alma Redemptoris Mater is the final Marian antiphon for the season from Advent through the Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary. The faithful ask Mary, Mother of the Redeemer, to help the falling people and have mercy on sinners.

seg.tr: Loving Mother of the Redeemer, who remain the open gate of heaven,
and star of the sea, help the people who are falling,
you who, while nature marvelled, gave birth to your holy Creator,

ex.w025: Mary bears the One who created her: Christ, her own Creator.

seg.tr: receiving that Ave from Gabriel's mouth, have mercy on sinners.
